resumes.rawText:
Alex Johnson
alex.johnson@example.com | (555) 234-5678 | San Francisco, CA | linkedin.com/in/alexjohnson-ml
SUMMARY
Lead Machine Learning Engineer with 6+ years designing large-scale NLP, PyTorch transformers,
multimodal perception systems, and distributed model inference services in cloud environments.
EDUCATION
Stanford University - Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (2016 - 2020)
Focus: Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, and Mathematical Statistics
SKILLS
Technical Skills: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Transformers, CUDA, HuggingFace
Systems: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, FastAPI, Ray, Vector Databases, PostgreSQL, Git
Specializations: Natural Language Processing, Model Optimization, RLHF, Embeddings, MLOps
EXPERIENCE
Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Scale AI (2022 - Present)
- Led fine-tuning and deployment of vision and language foundation models for enterprise workloads.
- Architected high-throughput inference microservices reducing p99 latency by 45%.
- Built automated continuous evaluation harnesses measuring vector alignment and model safety.
Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Databricks (2020 - 2022)
- Scaled distributed PyTorch training jobs over multi-node GPU clusters with Ray and Spark.
- Implemented feature store transformations and automated ETL pipelines for petabyte datasets.
PROJECTS
LLM Alignment & Evaluation Engine: Open-source preference optimization harness for frontier LLMs.
Real-Time Multimodal Search: Semantic vector similarity search engine indexing 50M+ items.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Lead the development and fine-tuning of state-of-the-art vision and multimodal models for enterprise generative applications. You will architect high-throughput inference pipelines, evaluate model latency vs accuracy trade-offs, and deploy resilient microservices in PyTorch and Flask/FastAPI.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist & Predictive Modeling
jobs.description: Design algorithmic models and statistical inference systems to uncover operational insights across Petabyte-scale enterprise workloads. Requires deep experience in mathematical statistics, Python, SQL data transformations, and end-to-end ML lifecycle governance.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Neuromorphic & Vision)
jobs.description: Investigate cutting-edge neural architectures, bio-inspired algorithms, and spiking neuromorphic processors. Partner with core research scientists to benchmark model representations and scale safety-aligned evaluations.

jobs.title: Staff LLM Alignment & Prompt Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Architect reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and direct preference optimization pipelines for multi-turn frontier models. Deploy evaluation harnesses measuring model calibration, safety boundaries, and reasoning capabilities.

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist & Experimentation Platform
jobs.description: Drive methodological innovation for global recommendation A/B testing and algorithmic experiment design. Build Bayesian experimentation engines analyzing viewer retention across 260M+ international subscribers.

jobs.title: Computer Vision & Deep Learning Specialist
jobs.description: Develop low-latency perception networks detecting dynamic obstacles in challenging weather conditions for autonomous vehicles. Optimize TensorRT models for real-time edge embedded accelerators.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Distributed Systems)
jobs.description: Architect mission-critical payment processing rails handling hundreds of billions in global commerce volume. You will lead cross-system resiliency initiatives, low-latency API contracts, and horizontally scalable transaction ledgers.

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Build developer-first interfaces and edge runtime telemetry tools. You will implement reactive React components, optimized server actions, responsive data dashboards, and real-time streaming architectures.

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Application Developer (Flutter & Swift)
jobs.description: Craft tactile, sub-50ms mobile experiences for product teams worldwide. Champion local-first sync engines, offline caching, buttery 120fps gesture transitions, and cross-platform native performance.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Go Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Scale the Git storage replication daemon powering 100M+ developer repositories. Optimize RPC throughput, eliminate lock contention in file metadata indices, and build self-healing storage partitions.

jobs.title: Principal Frontend Architect (Design Systems & WebGL)
jobs.description: Direct frontend engineering standards across thousands of merchant checkout workflows. Spearhead component accessibility audits, zero-runtime CSS tokens, and web performance budgets.

jobs.title: Rust Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Implement zero-copy packet parsers and high-speed cryptographic handshakes for the global edge network. Write bare-metal Rust targeting edge WebAssembly runtimes executing millions of requests per second.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps & Kubernetes Engineer
jobs.description: Scale multi-region container orchestration fabrics, automate infrastructure-as-code deployments using Terraform and Helm, and implement continuous verification pipelines with sub-second feedback loops.

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description: Design global enterprise cloud telemetry platforms ingesting trillions of log events daily. Partner with engineering directors to define multi-cloud networking, zero-trust security postures, and cost-efficient cloud topology.

jobs.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer (Chaos Engineering)
jobs.description: Define error budget policies and conduct automated failure-injection experiments to validate messaging reliability across enterprise grids. Lead post-incident retrospectives and automate self-remediating alerts.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Automate secrets management and workload identity federation across dynamic cloud clusters. Author Sentinel policy-as-code guardrails preventing credential leakages across multi-tenant environments.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Penetration Tester & Security Analyst
jobs.description: Perform adversary simulation assessments, offensive penetration testing, and forensic malware reverse-engineering. Build defensive automation tools and analyze application security vulnerabilities across cloud native stacks.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer (AppSec)
jobs.description: Conduct architecture threat modeling for institutional custody cryptographic enclaves. Implement automated SAST/DAST continuous security scans and audit smart contract security invariants before mainnet deployment.

jobs.title: Lead Incident Response & Threat Hunting Analyst
jobs.description: Investigate nation-state threat campaigns, extract Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), and write high-fidelity detection rules. Lead tier-3 emergency digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) engagements.

jobs.title: Senior Database Administrator & Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Ensure extreme reliability and low query latency across hundreds of thousands of managed PostgreSQL database instances. Tune WAL writer parameters, diagnose complex locking queries, and build automated shard rebalancing scripts.

jobs.title: Distributed Database Storage Engine Architect
jobs.description: Architect the core WiredTiger storage engine internals. Minimize lock contention during concurrent write spikes, implement compressed column-store indexing, and enhance distributed crash recovery guarantees.

jobs.title: Staff Big Data Engineer (Lakehouse & Spark)
jobs.description: Build real-time ACID ingestion pipelines handling tens of terabytes hourly. Optimize parquet partitioning, implement streaming join watermarking, and optimize shuffle stages across multi-thousand core Spark clusters.

jobs.title: Technical Agile Project & Product Manager
jobs.description: Lead cross-functional sprints across frontend rendering, WebAssembly, and collaborative cloud document sync teams. Drive outcome-focused roadmaps, unblock technical dependencies, and elevate team delivery velocity.

jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Design Technologist
jobs.description: Bridge high-fidelity design engineering with enterprise web security dashboards. Architect scalable Figma component registries, validate user accessibility patterns, and implement pixel-perfect design token systems.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management (Enterprise Developer Platforms)
jobs.description: Direct the multi-year product roadmap for Jira and developer workflow automation. Champion developer productivity telemetry, define monetization tiers, and partner with principal engineers on AI-assisted work orchestration.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager (Cloud Infra)
jobs.description: Drive multi-gigawatt cloud datacenter capacity deployments and fiber interconnect programs worldwide. Coordinate silicon supply chains, firmware qualification schedules, and global power redundancy audits.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (Design Systems & Micro-Interactions)
jobs.description: Craft joyful booking journeys and host onboarding experiences. Design dynamic interaction models, author comprehensive design guidelines, and collaborate closely with iOS and Web engineers on production polish.

jobs.title: QA Automation Lead & Software Engineer in Test
jobs.description: Architect automated end-to-end regression frameworks and performance benchmarks for Foundry enterprise data platforms. Build parallelized Playwright test runners integrating with continuous deployment gates.
